'''Anyul''' was a blonde, [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[20 ABY/Legends|20 ABY]]. She attained the rank of [[Sith Saber]] by [[44 ABY]], when she accompanied [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]'s strike force to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to ally with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in order to eliminate [[Abeloth]]. In the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]], she served aboard the ''[[Starstalker]]'', under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vyn Holpur]]. Shortly before the onset of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] with Skywalker, Taalon gave [[Leeha Faal]] an order to retrieve samples of [[wintrium]] from the [[Fountain of Ancients]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], an order which Faal passed on to Holpur. Holpur and the crew of the ''Starstalker'' carried out the [[Violation|mission]], with Anyul and fellow Sith Saber [[Marjaak]] attempting to collect the samples from the sacred Fountain. Despite interference by [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards, the Sith managed to take samples, but their escape was halted by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who were bound by the [[Treaty of Vontor]] to protect the Fountain. Holpur and his entire crew were later condemned to [[Death/Legends|death]] for their act.
